caption: The drawing shows a metallic andiron with a vertical shaft ending in a brass or gold-colored ornament at the top, which has a twisted, rounded, flame-like shape sitting above a geometric, faceted base. The shaft itself is primarily gray, suggesting a material like iron or steel. The base of the andiron splits into two curved legs, arching outward and ending in rounded feet, while a horizontal bar extends backward for stability or functional use in a fireplace. To the left, there is a line drawing of the same object, showing its shape and scale in black lines without any shading or color. The background is off-white or beige, with a thin double-ruled border framing the entire composition.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
